basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old tech enthusiast from Canada, currently working as a junior software developer. I have a keen interest in cyberpunk themes and enjoy vibrant music festivals, especially those with indie bands like Rainbow Kitten Surprise. I recently started exploring Reddit to exchange tips on gaming and tech. I'm not yet familiar with all the ins and outs of the site. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been passionate about technology since my teens. I often self-teach through online courses and forums. Recently, I've been exploring the intersection of technology and lifestyle, particularly in low-sodium cyberpunk aesthetics.
